_about: Make-row category 'Shops & squares' (Core/Tool/Shelf.cs; one file per category). Hidden things keep their code and the game runner still builds them by id. Strip malls and plazas (2026-10-28, the user: "bring back strip malls ... refine them to be excellent ... plazas is going to be its whole new category"): the category is Shops (strip malls: classic, corner retail as a real L, big box, plaza and pond rows; mall district: shopping district, downtown); the squares and the plaza-like shopping types moved to Recipes/shelf/plazas.json.
